resources.string: Independent open source project. Not affiliated with, endorsed or supported by Anthropic. “Claude” is a trademark of Anthropic. This app only shows the official claude.ai website.
Lets the owner lock this phone to OldPhoneClaude (dedicated mode).
Google often refuses to sign in inside apps like this one. If you see an error, go back and choose “Continue with email”.
The shared file could not be read.
Text copied. Touch and hold the message box, then choose Paste.
This kind of download is not supported by this web engine.
No app on this phone can do that.
Links to other sites are off in dedicated mode (%1$s).
No browser is installed to open this link.
No app store found. Update “Android System WebView” from your store or Android settings.
Microphone not allowed. Touch here to open the app permissions.
Camera not allowed. Touch here to open the app permissions.

This phone has no speech recognition service. Install or enable one (for example “Speech Recognition & Synthesis” by Google) and try again. You can still type, or use the voice button inside the page.
Listening… say “new chat”, “open projects”, “back”, or your message.
I did not hear anything. Touch the microphone and try again.
Speech recognition needs the network right now. Check the connection.
Speech recognition did not work. Try again.
Copied: “%1$s”. Touch and hold the message box, then choose Paste.
Reading aloud is off. The owner can turn it on in the owner menu.
No reply found to read. Select the text in the page, then touch Read.
No text-to-speech engine is available on this phone.
Check that Wi-Fi is on and connected. The page reloads by itself when the network is back.
The phone could not verify the site’s security certificate.

First check the date and time. If they are right: Android 7.0 and older do not know the certificate authorities used by websites today, and the web engine of the phone relies on Android for that. On Android 8 or newer, update the web engine or use the gecko edition.
The web engine is too old
Claude’s site needs a recent browser engine, and the one on this phone (Android System WebView) is older than the oldest one known to work.
What to do: open your app store, search “Android System WebView” and update it. If no newer version is offered, this Android version cannot run the site with this engine.
You can also switch to the built-in GeckoView engine in the owner menu (Web engine).
You can also install the “gecko” edition of this app, which brings its own engine (Android 8 or newer).
Android System WebView is missing, disabled or being updated right now.
claude.ai loaded but stayed empty. This usually means the web engine on this phone is too old for the site.
The engine crashed several times in a row, probably because the phone ran out of memory.
Restart the phone and remove or disable apps you do not need.
The page could not be loaded
Something went wrong while loading claude.ai.
It protects the owner menu (Wi-Fi, settings, unlocking). 4 to 12 digits. Write it down: it cannot be recovered.
Turn this phone into a Claude device
A few short steps, then you sign in with your own Claude account on the official site.
Choose the language of the buttons and messages.
The phone is not connected. Connect it to your Wi-Fi, then come back here.
The web engine on this phone looks recent enough.
Needed to talk to Claude and to dictate messages. It is only used while you speak.
Needed to take photos and attach them to a chat.
Not allowed. You can continue and allow it later from the owner menu.
How will you use this phone?
As the Home screen, the phone always comes back to Claude when you press Home and after a restart.
Use it as a normal app
Stronger locking (screen pinning, dedicated mode) is in the owner menu and in the project guide.
Open Android settings → Apps → Default apps → Home app, and choose OldPhoneClaude.
Next comes the official Claude sign-in page. Choose “Continue with email”: sign-in with Google is usually refused inside apps like this one.
Good to know: the big button listens to you. Keep it pressed for 3 seconds to open the owner menu (PIN required).
For sign-in by email: copy the link from the message and paste it here. Only https://claude.ai links are accepted.
That is not a https://claude.ai link.
Open this page in the browser
This removes the site’s cookies from this phone, so you will have to sign in again. To end the session on Anthropic’s side too, use “Log out” in the page’s own menu first.
This removes cookies, storage and cache of the web engine. You will have to sign in again.
Only needed if your organisation signs in through its own site. Other sites always open in the browser.
Each engine keeps its own sign-in: you will sign in again after switching.
This edition uses only the phone’s own engine (Android System WebView). The “gecko” edition adds a second engine for Android 8 or newer.
Type dictated text into the message box

Fragile: it depends on how the page is built and may stop working when the site changes. When off or broken, dictated text is copied so you can paste it. Speech is processed by the phone’s recognition service (often Google’s).
Uses the phone’s text-to-speech. Fragile for the same reason; selecting text in the page and touching Read always works.

Choose OldPhoneClaude as the digital assistant app and the phone’s assistant gesture (long press on Home, or the power button on some phones) starts listening. There is no always-on “Hey Claude”: the phone never listens with the screen off.
Keep the screen on while charging
Dark rest screen with a moving clock
Android asks for confirmation. To unpin, hold Back and Overview together (or swipe up and hold with gesture navigation).
Dedicated mode (no system bars, no notifications, no way out without the PIN) needs a computer with adb once. See docs/DEDICATED-DEVICE in the project.
Dedicated mode (lock the phone to this app)
Takes effect when you go back to Claude. Turn it off here to use the phone normally again.
The app goes back to being an ordinary app that can be uninstalled. Getting dedicated mode back requires a factory reset and adb again.
Device owner removed. The phone is a normal phone again.
Could not remove device owner. See the guide for the other ways out.
Check for updates (opens the project page)
Turn off dedicated mode first, or visit %1$s/releases from another device.
The app never checks or downloads anything by itself.
OldPhoneClaude %1$s · Apache License 2.0 · source: %2$s\nNo analytics, no ads, no server of the author. No Anthropic API and no API key: you use your own account on the official site.
